import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from shiny import App, reactive, render, ui

MAX_SEQ_LEN = 150

DEFAULT_SEQ1 = "ATGGTGCACCTGACTCCTGAGGAGAAGTCTGCCGTTACTGCCCTGTGGGGCAAGGTGAACGTGGATGAAGTTGGTGGTGAGGCCCTGGGCAG"
DEFAULT_SEQ2 = "ATGGTGCACCTGACTCCTGAGGAGATCCACGTTCACCTTGCCCCACAGGGCAGTAACGGCAGACTTGAAGTTGGTGGTGAGGCCCTGGGCAG"


PROTEIN_SEQ1 = "MVHLTPEEKSAVTALWGKVNVDEVGGEALGRLLVVYPWTQRFFESFGDLSTPDAVMGNPKVKAHGKKVLGAFSDGLAHLDNLKGTFATLSELHCDKLHVDPENFRLLGNVLVCVLAHHFGKEFTPPVQAAYQKVVAGVANALAHKYH"
PROTEIN_SEQ2 = "MGLSDGEWQLVLNVWGKVEADIPGHGQEVLIRLFKGHPETLEKFDKFKHLKSEDEMKASEDLKKHGATVLTALSHHEAEIKPLAQSHATKHKIPVKYLEFISECIIQVLQSKHPGDFGADAQGAMNKALELFRKDMASNYKELGFQG"

app_ui = ui.page_sidebar(
    ui.sidebar(
        ui.h4("Sequence Inputs"),
        ui.input_select(
            "seq_type",
            "Sequence Type",
            choices={"dna": "DNA / RNA", "protein": "Protein"},
            selected="dna"),
            
        ui.input_text_area(
            "seq1",
            f"Sequence 1 (X-axis, max {MAX_SEQ_LEN})",
            value=DEFAULT_SEQ1,
            rows=4,
            placeholder=f"Paste FASTA or raw sequence (auto-truncated at {MAX_SEQ_LEN})..."),
            
        ui.output_text("seq1_count"),
        
        ui.input_text_area(
            "seq2",
            f"Sequence 2 (Y-axis, max {MAX_SEQ_LEN})",
            value=DEFAULT_SEQ2,
            rows=4,
            placeholder=f"Paste FASTA or raw sequence (auto-truncated at {MAX_SEQ_LEN})..."),
            
        ui.output_text("seq2_count"),
        
        ui.hr(),
        
        ui.h4("Dotplot Parameters"),
        
        ui.input_slider("window_size", "Window Size", min=1, max=30, value=5, step=1),
        
        ui.input_slider("step_size", "Window Step Size", min=1, max=20, value=1, step=1),
        
        ui.input_slider("threshold", "Stringency (Min Matches)", min=1, max=30, value=4, step=1),
        
        ui.output_ui("rev_comp_ui"),
        ui.div(
            ui.input_action_button(
                "load_dna",
                "Load Sample DNA",
                class_="btn-outline-primary btn-sm"),
                
            ui.input_action_button(
                "load_protein",
                "Load Sample Protein",
                class_="btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"),
                
            class_="d-flex gap-2 mt-2 flex-wrap"),
        width=320),
        
    ui.card(
        ui.card_header("Sequence Dotplot"),
        ui.output_plot("dotplot", height="650px")),
        
    title="Dotplot Generator")


def parse_raw_sequence(raw_seq: str) -> str:
    """Strips FASTA headers, whitespace, and converts to uppercase without truncating."""
    lines = raw_seq.strip().splitlines()
    return "".join(line.strip() for line in lines if not line.startswith(">")).upper().replace(" ", "")


def clean_sequence(raw_seq: str, max_len: int = MAX_SEQ_LEN) -> str:
    """Cleans sequence and automatically truncates to max_len."""
    return parse_raw_sequence(raw_seq)[:max_len]


def reverse_complement(seq: str) -> str:
    """Returns the reverse complement of a DNA/RNA sequence."""
    return seq.translate(str.maketrans("ACGTU", "TGCAA"))[::-1]


def compute_dotplot_coords(seq1: str, seq2: str, window: int, threshold: int, step: int = 1):
    """Vectorized sliding-window match computation with configurable step size."""
    n, m = len(seq1), len(seq2)
    if n < window or m < window:
        return np.array([]), np.array([])

    arr1 = np.frombuffer(seq1.encode("ascii"), dtype=np.uint8)
    arr2 = np.frombuffer(seq2.encode("ascii"), dtype=np.uint8)

    match_matrix = (arr2[:, None] == arr1[None, :]).astype(np.int16)

    rows, cols = match_matrix.shape
    out_rows = rows - window + 1
    out_cols = cols - window + 1

    diag_sums = np.zeros(
        (len(range(0, out_rows, step)), len(range(0, out_cols, step))),
        dtype=np.int16)

    for offset in range(window):
        diag_sums += match_matrix[
            offset : offset + out_rows : step,
            offset : offset + out_cols : step]

    y_idx, x_idx = np.where(diag_sums >= threshold)
    
    return x_idx * step, y_idx * step


def server(input, output, session):
    def apply_dna_defaults():
        ui.update_text_area("seq1", value=DEFAULT_SEQ1)
        ui.update_text_area("seq2", value=DEFAULT_SEQ2)
        ui.update_slider("window_size", value=5)
        ui.update_slider("step_size", value=1)
        ui.update_slider("threshold", max=5, value=4)

    def apply_protein_defaults():
        ui.update_text_area("seq1", value=PROTEIN_SEQ1)
        ui.update_text_area("seq2", value=PROTEIN_SEQ2)
        ui.update_slider("window_size", value=7)
        ui.update_slider("step_size", value=1)
        ui.update_slider("threshold", max=7, value=3)

    @render.ui
    def rev_comp_ui():
        is_dna = input.seq_type() == "dna"
        checkbox = ui.input_checkbox(
            "rev_comp",
            "Show Reverse Complement (DNA only)",
            value=is_dna)
        
        if not is_dna:
            checkbox.children[0].attrs["disabled"] = "disabled"
        
        return checkbox

    @reactive.effect
    def _sync_sliders():
        win = input.window_size()
        ui.update_slider("threshold", max=win, value=min(input.threshold(), win))

    @render.text
    def seq1_count():
        raw_len = len(parse_raw_sequence(input.seq1()))
        if raw_len > MAX_SEQ_LEN:
            return f"Length: {MAX_SEQ_LEN} / {MAX_SEQ_LEN} (truncated from {raw_len})"
        
        return f"Length: {raw_len} / {MAX_SEQ_LEN}"

    @render.text
    def seq2_count():
        raw_len = len(parse_raw_sequence(input.seq2()))
        if raw_len > MAX_SEQ_LEN:
            return f"Length: {MAX_SEQ_LEN} / {MAX_SEQ_LEN} (truncated from {raw_len})"
        
        return f"Length: {raw_len} / {MAX_SEQ_LEN}"

    @reactive.effect
    @reactive.event(input.seq_type, ignore_init=True)
    def _on_seq_type_change():
        if input.seq_type() == "dna":
            apply_dna_defaults()
        
        else:
            apply_protein_defaults()

    @reactive.effect
    @reactive.event(input.load_dna)
    def _load_sample_dna():
        if input.seq_type() != "dna":
            ui.update_select("seq_type", selected="dna")
        else:
            apply_dna_defaults()

    @reactive.effect
    @reactive.event(input.load_protein)
    def _load_sample_protein():
        if input.seq_type() != "protein":
            ui.update_select("seq_type", selected="protein")
        else:
            apply_protein_defaults()

    @render.plot
    def dotplot():
        s1 = clean_sequence(input.seq1())
        s2 = clean_sequence(input.seq2())
        win = input.window_size()
        step = input.step_size()
        thresh = input.threshold()
        is_dna = input.seq_type() == "dna"

        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8))

        if not s1 or not s2:
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "Enter two valid sequences.", ha="center", va="center")
            return fig

        # Forward matches (bottom-left to top-right)
        x_fwd, y_fwd = compute_dotplot_coords(s1, s2, win, thresh, step)
        ax.scatter(x_fwd, y_fwd, s=10, c="#1f77b4", alpha=0.85, label="Forward Match", clip_on=False)

        # Reverse complement matches (top-left to bottom-right)
        if is_dna and input.rev_comp():
            s2_rc = reverse_complement(s2)
            x_rev, y_rev_rc = compute_dotplot_coords(s1, s2_rc, win, thresh, step)
            y_rev = (len(s2) - win) - y_rev_rc
            ax.scatter(x_rev, y_rev, s=10, c="#d62728", alpha=0.75, label="Reverse Complement", clip_on=False)

        # Origin (0, 0) at bottom-left
        ax.set_xlim(0, len(s1))
        ax.set_ylim(0, len(s2))
        ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")

        ax.set_xlabel(f"Sequence 1 ({len(s1)} {'bp' if is_dna else 'aa'})", fontsize=11)
        ax.set_ylabel(f"Sequence 2 ({len(s2)} {'bp' if is_dna else 'aa'})", fontsize=11)
        ax.set_title(
            f"Dotplot (Window: {win}, Step: {step}, Threshold: {thresh})",
            fontsize=12,
            pad=12)
            
        ax.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.3)

        if is_dna and input.rev_comp():
            ax.legend(loc="lower right", markerscale=2.0)

        fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.14, right=0.96, top=0.92, bottom=0.10)
        return fig


app = App(app_ui, server)
